$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOU (AIP France, chart dated 2026-06-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 204, due to IFR procedure
notes: Simultaneous use of both RWYs prohibited.
Unpaved RWY not available after heavy rain.
TORA RWY 20 = 1290 m Reduced TORA and TODA RWY 20 due to road gauge located in take-off funnel.
Use of unpaved RWY reserved for ACFT authorized by AD operator outside gliders activity hours.
Outside ATS SKED, entrance and exit of unpaved RWY must be performed in front of the terminal.
"Low height" circuits: during training flights only with an instructor on board: minimum 500 AAL, West of RWY 02/20.
Preferred QFU: 204° due to IFR procedure.
TKOF QFU 024°: outside ATS SKED, backtracking and lining up only from holding point A.
From East apron, join holding point A via TWY C and B.
TKOF QFU 204°: line up at RWY threshold to avoid noise.
After TKOF: take initial departure heading 267°.
TWY C reserved for ACFT with wingspan less than 15 m.
RWY pattern training forbidden between 2100 and 0700 (SUM: - 1 HR).
Aerobatics NR 6390: see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM NR 8308: see AIP ENR 5.5
